profile.name: CVD沉积工艺控制系统
profile.description: 用于化学气相沉积（CVD）实验的工艺控制设备/系统，通常包含反应腔体加热温控、工艺配方（步骤）执行，以及多路工艺气体的流量设定与监控（常见为质量流量控制器MFC）。可按配方启动/停止工艺，并记录或回放工艺设定与相关参数变化。
profile.description_en: A process control system for Chemical Vapor Deposition (CVD) experiments, typically integrating reactor temperature setpoint control, recipe (step) execution, and multi-gas flow setpoint/monitoring (commonly via mass flow controllers, MFCs). It supports starting/stopping a recipe and managing process setpoints and parameter trends during deposition runs.

A process control system for Chemical Vapor Deposition (CVD) experiments, typically integrating reactor temperature setpoint control, recipe (step) execution, and multi-gas flow setpoint/monitoring (commonly via mass flow controllers, MFCs). It supports starting/stopping a recipe and managing process setpoints and parameter trends during deposition runs.
